subject: Embedded Demo Tracks & MDF allocation for joint customer roadshow
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@galileocloud.io>, Tom Briggs <tom@galileocloud.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Embedded Demo Tracks & MDF allocation for joint customer roadshow

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks for taking the time last week. Per our call, I sketched a concise plan for a two-day co-hosted roadshow in SF that focuses on "embedded demo" tracks (hands-on product walk-throughs embedded within customer environments) plus an evening executive roundtable. Key asks from our side:

- MDF request: $45,000 to cover venue, A/V, local demand gen, and paid social.
- Proposed split: Redwood 50% / Galileo 50% (flexible, happy to discuss).
- Deliverables: co-branded registration page, joint email nurture (6 weeks), live demo staff (2 engineers), 2 recorded demos to reuse as sales assets.
- Goals: 200 MQLs across the program, 30 pipeline meetings, 3 enterprise opportunities (>$75k ARR).
- Proposed dates: Oct 12–13, 2026 (we can slide +/- one week).

Attached a first-pass MOU and an agenda matrix (embedded-demo-agenda.xlsx). Can you confirm whether Galileo can commit to the $45k MDF and the lead targets above? If you have venue preferences or budget constraints, let me know and we can rework the split.

Next steps I propose:
1) agree MDF and MQL commitment
2) finalize agenda and speakers
3) sign MOU and lock venue by 9/3

Appreciate it — I think this is a strong joint GTM for Q4.

– Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena@galileocloud.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom@galileocloud.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Embedded Demo Tracks & MDF allocation for joint customer roadshow

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan. Happy to co-host and we like the embedded-demo format. A few quick notes:

- MDF: Galileo can commit $45k total, but we'd prefer a 60/40 split in our favor if Redwood will lead the demo engineering deliverables.
- Venue: we have a preferred partner (MarketHall SF) that can handle 150–180 attendees. They quoted $18k for the space + basic A/V.
- Lead expectations: we generally see conversion rates of ~12% from paid social to MQL for this audience; 200 MQLs is aggressive but possible if we both push paid channels and our partner lists.

We can tentatively hold Oct 12–13 but need final confirmation and the signed MOU by 9/3 to lock the MarketHall rate. I reviewed the MOU and left two comments in the doc about usage rights for recorded demos.

On pricing/split, do you have flexibility to take more of the demo staffing effort in exchange for a 50/50 split? If Redwood handles on-site demo staffing and the post-event nurture, we can meet you at 50/50.

— Elena
Elena Rossi | Head of Partnerships | Galileo Cloud

Looping in a couple internal details from growth/field:

- Lead gen: if we are to agree to a 50/50 MDF split we should require a minimum of 225 MQLs (to protect unit economics). If Galileo is at 200, we should ask for $5k additional MDF or a paid social uplift commitment.
- Measurement: Redwood will require access to registration and UTM-level performance data. Please add a clause to the MOU for shared reporting within 10 business days post-event.
- Assets: Redwood can produce two short demo videos and run the 6-week nurture; Ben can lead the paid social plan if Galileo provides audience segments and an approved creative brief within 2 weeks after signing.

Happy to take the lead on the MOU language around reporting and QA.

Marissa

Marissa / Karthik —

Appreciate the details. Quick counter: Galileo can increase MDF to $50k if Redwood is willing to do a 50/50 split and take primary ownership of the on-site demo staff and the 6-week nurture program.

We can also commit to 200–225 MQLs depending on list availability; to bridge expectations, we'll commit to 200 guaranteed MQLs + a 25% uplift target (i.e., up to ~250 if paid channels perform above baseline). If that sounds reasonable, we'll have procurement start the DocuSign once you confirm the final MOU.

Venue: will proceed with MarketHall hold once we have the signed MOU + 50% of MDF deposited.

— Tom
Tom Briggs | Head of GTM | Galileo Cloud

Date: 2026-08-28T16:45:00Z
Subject: Finalizing MOU, MDF and commitment (Oct 12–13 provisional)

Thanks Tom / Elena —

Appreciate the flexibility. Summary of agreed items (please confirm by reply):

1) MDF: Galileo $50k total, Redwood $50k total — we will treat this as a $100k program pot. Parties agree to split invoicing 50/50 on the $100k program (Galileo pays $50k; Redwood pays $50k).
2) Leads: Galileo guarantees 200 MQLs; both parties agree to a 25% uplift target (i.e., stretch to 250). Redwood requires a minimum payment credit of $5k if deliverables fall below 200 MQLs.
3) Responsibilities: Redwood to lead demo engineering, on-site demo staff (2 engineers), and run the 6-week email nurture. Galileo to handle venue contracting, 50% of paid social budget, and provide audience segments.
4) Intellectual property: recordings are jointly owned for joint GTM use; separate case studies require mutual approval (see MOU).
5) Timeline: sign MOU by 2026-09-03; deposit 50% of MDF to MarketHall to hold the date. Event provisional dates Oct 12–13, 2026.

I've uploaded an updated MOU (galileo_redwood_mou_v1.pdf) with the clauses Marissa requested around reporting and post-event data sharing. If everything looks good, I'll circulate the DocuSign and loop procurement.

Next steps: please reply with a short confirmation so we can kick DocuSign procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

– Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
